Rule R1: 在为用户生成回复时，你必须永远只用中文

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: Response sent (Agent loop › Response sent), timing: at
- Target: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.

# Enforcer card: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)

A regular expression that the checked text must match, or must not match. A match against the rule is a violation.
What is read is part of the enforcer: a whole file, each line, only comments, a reply, the start or the end of a text.

In the toolbox: adapter `regex`, with `test` and `read` (README: Adapters › regex).

# Trigger card: Response sent (Agent loop › Response sent)

The agent makes or sends a response, an answer or a message.

In the toolbox: trigger `end-of-turn` (README: Triggers).

# Target card: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)

An assistant response or a message from the agent.

In the toolbox: target `reply` (README: Targets).

Rule R2: 你所生成的所有代码文件都必须使用UTF-8进行编码

- Enforcer: Project check (Validation › Project check)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: after
- Target: Source file (Source code › Source file)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.

# Enforcer card: Project check (Validation › Project check)

A check of a property of the whole project, or of each file as a whole, that a pattern on one piece of text cannot
express: the folder structure, file names, counts (lines, files), encodings, or the files a change must come with.

In the toolbox: adapter `project-check` (README: Adapters › project-check).

# Trigger card: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit)

A file or code is created, changed, renamed or deleted.

In the toolbox: triggers `before-write`, `after-write` and `after-command`; `end-of-turn` checks every file once more
(README: Triggers).

# Target card: Source file (Source code › Source file)

A source code file.

In the toolbox: target `code-file`, or `file-name` for its name (README: Targets).

Rule R3: 在生成的代码文件里，缩进必须严格保持为 4 个空格

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: at
- Target: Source file (Source code › Source file)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.

Rule R4: 你提供的代码文件不得含有制表符，请仅使用空格完成代码的缩进

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: none
- Target: Source file (Source code › Source file)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.

Rule R5: 生成代码时，请在“=”号的左侧和右侧各放置两个空格

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: at
- Target: Source file (Source code › Source file)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.

Rule R6: 你所输出的代码文件里，针对各个函数名的命名规范是：首字母严禁小写，首字母之外的字符严禁大写

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: none
- Target: Name / identifier (Source code › Name / identifier)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.

# Target card: Name / identifier (Source code › Name / identifier)

A name: a variable, function, file or other identifier.

In the toolbox: target `names`, or `file-name` for a file's name (README: Targets, the names helper).

Rule R7: 你所编写的代码文件内，所有类名的长度均需恰好为质数，不得有例外

- Enforcer: Semgrep (Analysis › Code scans › Semgrep)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: at
- Target: Class / type (Source code › Class / type)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.

# Enforcer card: Semgrep (Analysis › Code scans › Semgrep)

A pattern-based static analyzer. A rule is a code pattern that Semgrep matches against each file's syntax tree, for
many languages.

In the toolbox: adapter `semgrep`, installed with `enforce install semgrep` (README: Adapters › semgrep).

# Target card: Class / type (Source code › Class / type)

A class, a type, an interface or a struct.

In the toolbox: target `names` with `kinds` `class` and `type` (README: Targets, the names helper).

Rule R8: 必须保证输出的每一份代码文件，其文件名包含的字符个数严格等于奇数

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: after
- Target: Source file (Source code › Source file)

Implement system enforcement for this rule with this enforcer, at this trigger, on this target.
